meaning: Historical mathematical diagnostics plus edition integrity checks. No mathematical program was rerun by edition preparation. Independent audits, not finite extrapolation, assess the full written proofs.

independent_field_audit.arithmetic: Exact integer convolution and rational reductions, with explicit checked convolution overflow bounds.

independent_rounding_audit.arithmetic: Direct four-index enumeration with integer numerators.

indicator_phase.scope: Finite identities and countercontrols; written proofs establish asymptotic phases and rounding theorem. No kappa=1/14 disproof or proof.

author.scope: All nonzero mu, all translations in both cosets, algebraic and incidence checks. All character tuples only at order 3; nine selected tuples at each larger order. Conservative small-field bounds can be vacuous.
author.mode_limit: Final guarded program uses assertions and refuses optimized execution. An earlier exploratory -O smoke run has no mathematical-verification status. No -O/-OO author pass is claimed.

independent.arithmetic: Finite field algebra, lift carries and deletion coverage are exact; global Fourier and local character sums are floating-point numerical diagnostics.
independent.mode_limit: Only the recorded independent run is claimed. No independent -O/-OO execution is inferred.
independent.global_character_scope: All reduced nonprincipal global tuples for field orders at most 9; covers four-character tuples up to the exact unit scalar.
independent.local_character_scope: All nonprincipal local pairs on nonexcluded slices for field orders at most 13.
independent.lift_scope: Every translation and unit dilation in both lift conventions for orders at most 11; 12 selected affine choices at orders 13 and 17, each in both conventions.
independent.subset_scope: All subset/lift combinations for orders 3 and 5.

bose_chowla_carries.scope: Finite fields can have zero-carry-free full lifts. No effective positivity threshold, optimal error/deletion bound, or asymptotic extrapolation is claimed. Analytic proof uses established function-field Dirichlet RH.

independent.scope: Finite diagnostics supplement a separate full proof audit; no integer realization or universal target theorem is certified.
independent.arithmetic: Exact direct window counts and rational comparisons in Q(sqrt(2)); rational continuum grids supplement the full analytic proof.

asymmetric_capacity.scope: Conditional finite transfer assumes a symmetric-core theorem. Exact relaxation maxima do not claim integer realizations. Uniform/proportional subclass needs extra hypotheses.

edition_checks.public_scope: Only authored prose and aggregate public verification/source metadata. No executable or source artifact distribution.
edition_checks.integration_limit: Separate fresh exact-head review is required. No repository publication, push, PR update, queue update or CI result is asserted by this edition.
